'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male Royan found speaking to a researcher, '''Vitruvio''', near by the Resonance Beacon of [[Atuja Camp]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Vitruvio:''' May I ask why your people don't settle within Bjartr Woods?
:'''Alviss: '''For the Soliskin, Bjartr Woods is home. It is there they rest, grow, and return to the Solistrees at the very end.
:'''Alviss:''' We Shepherds watch and tend to them, but disturb their rest we do not. Neither do we infringe on their freedom.
:'''Vitruvio:''' I see... so only Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods most of the time?
:'''Alviss:''' Yes, child. When we enter, we pitch only a small tent, so the forest remains theirs. That is also why Haldarheim was built :outside the woods.
:'''Alviss:''' All things human—our rituals, out trade, our crafting—we do away from the woods. Only the Solisylum's calculations remain.
:'''Alviss:''' Only when we lay aside human noise and enter in reverence can we come close to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition.
{{Dialogue End}}
